what: When several full-screen-height sections stack one after another, from when each section’s bottom touches the screen bottom until it leaves the top of the screen (while the next section covers it), the section follows the scroll at only 50% of its own height and sinks under the next section. The center photo tilts 0 → -5° while rising backwards at -50% of its own height, the text group drops out faster at -100%, and the back half is covered by a veil of the same color as the section going 0 → 1 so it fades. There are no curves, it is tied directly to scroll. Overflow outside the group is clipped so the last section sinks the same way under the next content

options.push: Share the section follows down (% of its own height), default 50
options.tilt: Photo tilt angle (deg), default -5 — 0 means straight
options.lift: Share the photo rises (% of its own height), default -50
options.copy: Amount the text block rises (% of its own height), default -100
options.[data-fx-part=section]: Stacking Section — set the background color on the Section (the act inherits that color)
options.[data-fx-part=media]·[data-fx-part=copy]: Photo, text group and blur veil inside a section (use if present, skip if not)

use:
